You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0296.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > make.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
# coords correspond to vertices of provided 2-D image in pixels
raw=[('C',446,337),('C',361,252),('C',322,299),('C',562,313),('C',392,135),('C',307,51),('C',192,82),('C',87,21),('C',20,127),('C',81,231),('C',50,347),('C',135,430),('C',251,400),('N',337,491),('C',215,451),('C',279,559),('C',397,527),('C',390,409),('C',506,379),('N',575,462),('C',512,558),('C',450,454),('C',411,465),('C',696,433),('C',541,623),('O',460,711),('C',635,651),('O',691,553),('C',697,727),('C',687,840),('C',812,871),('C',891,783),('C',891,688),('C',980,639),('C',980,517),('C',875,459),('C',778,491),('O',618,317)]
m=Chem.RWMol()
for el,x,y in raw:m.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el))
bonds=[(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(0,21),(1,4),(4,5),(5,6),(6,7),(7,8),(8,9),(9,10),(10,11),(11,12),(12,13),(13,14),(14,15),(15,16),(16,17),(17,2),(17,18),(18,19),(19,20),(20,16),(21,20),(21,22),(19,23),(23,36),(20,24),(24,25),(24,26),(26,27),(26,28),(28,29),(29,30),(30,31),(31,32),(32,33),(33,34),(34,35),(35,36),(3,37)]
doubles=[(28,29),(30,31),(33,34),(3,37)]
for i,j in bonds:m.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if (i,j) in doubles else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=m.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
for i,j,side1,side2,stereo in [(28,29,26,30,Chem.BondStereo.STEREOE),(30,31,29,32,Chem.BondStereo.STEREOZ),(33,34,32,35,Chem.BondStereo.STEREOZ)]:
 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j);b.SetStereoAtoms(side1,side2);b.SetStereo(stereo)
# extract absolute stereochemistry from three-dimensional lift of drawn wedges
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms());conf.Set3D(True)
for i,(elem,x,y) in enumerate(raw):
 z= -1.05 if i==2 else (1.05 if i in (25,27) else 0)
 conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(x/90.,-y/90.,z))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
for atom in m.GetAtoms():
 if atom.GetIdx() not in (0,24,26):atom.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,force=True,cleanIt=True)
for i in [0,24,26]:print('center',i,'tag',m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetChiralTag(),'CIP',m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode') if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
print('SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(m,isomericSmiles=True),'formula',__import__('rdkit').Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
m.RemoveAllConformers()
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'molecule.mol')
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=42;p.numThreads=8;p.maxIterations=500;p.useRandomCoords=False;p.pruneRmsThresh=0.8
n=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=36,params=p)
print('embedded',len(n),flush=True)
if len(n)==0:
 p.useRandomCoords=True;p.maxIterations=1200;n=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=32,params=p);print('random embedded',len(n),flush=True)
if not n:raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
energies=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=8,maxIters=500)
print('optimized',[(x,round(y,2)) for x,y in energies],flush=True)
best=min(range(len(energies)),key=lambda i: energies[i][1]);print('best',best,energies[best]);
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'optimized.mol',confId=best)
conf=m.GetConformer(best)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from 2D structure; MMFF94 optimized 3D conformer\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  q=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx());f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {q.x:14.7f} {q.y:14.7f} {q.z:14.7f}\n')
PY
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python make.py > build.log 2>&1 & echo $!
cat build.log; ls -lh answer.xyz molecule.mol 2>/dev/null; ps -p 3832258 -o etime,cmd
